s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection
salient_findings: Eroded, crusted papule on the left forehead
Granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts
key_facts: Presented with a tender nodule on her forehead
History of bumping her forehead on an air-conditioning unit several months prior
Denied fever, neck stiffness, and photophobia
Lived alone with a pet cat and spent minimal time outdoors
No recent exposure to systemic steroids
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

raw.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection

shortlist.label: Cryptococcosis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts and tissue culture grew Cryptococcus neoformans

shortlist.label: Sporotrichosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation, although less likely given the biopsy results

shortlist.label: Histoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection, but less likely given the specific biopsy findings

shortlist.label: Blastomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection, but less likely given the specific biopsy findings and lack of exposure history

shortlist.label: Chromoblastomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation, but less likely given the specific biopsy findings and clinical presentation

raw.rationale: The skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts with thick capsules, and tissue culture grew Cryptococcus neoformans, which is consistent with Cryptococcosis.

rejected.label: Sporotrichosis
rejected.why: Sporotrichosis typically presents with a history of trauma and exposure to soil or plants, which is not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Histoplasmosis
rejected.why: Histoplasmosis is more commonly associated with exposure to bird or bat droppings and typically presents with respiratory symptoms, which are not present in this case.

rejected.label: Blastomycosis
rejected.why: Blastomycosis typically presents with respiratory symptoms and is more commonly associated with exposure to soil or water, which is not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Chromoblastomycosis
rejected.why: Chromoblastomycosis is a chronic fungal infection of the skin and subcutaneous tissue, but the presence of narrow-budding yeasts with thick capsules in the skin biopsy is more consistent with Cryptococcosis.
